verifiedSemantics: The fixed model selects fused_recurrent at Q<=64 and chunk at Q>64. ShortConvolution uses the in-place step only for one token; multi-token forward emits a new final W-slot buffer.

Recurrent prefill carries FP32 state on chip through the whole query sequence, loading/storing one initial/final matrix. Chunk uses size 64, local gate prefix sums, intra Aqk/Akk, a triangular solve, WY preparation, inter-chunk states/new values and final output.

Aqk and raw Akk allocate B*Q*N*64 FP32 entries, solved Akk is BF16, W/U/KG and new values are BF16, chunk-state history has ceil(Q/64) BF16 matrices, final state is FP32. Chunk matrix dots cast operands to BF16 with FP32 accumulation, while gate/intra/solve work uses FP32 arithmetic.
Full attention prefill computes dense Q-by-Q scores with a causal mask and FP32 softmax followed by BF16 probabilities; it cannot reuse the one-query decode formula.
authoredAssumptions: Cold prefill with explicit initialized zero buffers and C=0, Q=2..64 for short or 65..256 for chunk. Q=1 remains the fixed decode preset. Four attention/input-norm/residual fragments; no FFN/MoE or full-model weight loading, startup/zero-fill, varlen, backward or full-model inference execution. Declared projection/norm weights remain included in cost and allocation. Miniature H=8,N=2,D=4,W=4,R=4,P=2 follows the separate decode study's declared precision.

Each weight is read once per batched leaf. Convolution uses declared direct-stencil logical HBM reads, including final-tail copy; no unstated cache reuse or per-Triton-block weight replay. Causal zero-padding contributes execution but not useful dot work. Its old/new three-buffer coexistence is conservatively retained over the whole KDA module using allocation-only workspace, rather than simulating Python pointers.

Short recurrence loads/stores the FP32 matrix once. Chunk uses a mathematical stage ledger, not a CUDA instruction counter: valid causal pairs define useful work; fixed 64-token tiles define executed intra/solve/dot work. Channel tiling, launch tuning and actual Tensor Core tile padding are not inferred from the artificial D=4 shape. Exponential/normalization/triangular-solve operations use stated scalar proxies.

Chunk tensors preserve source logical dtypes and row storage Q*64, not ceil(Q/64)*64*64. Last-use materialization releases raw Akk after solve and WY matrices after inter-state processing. Allocation-only new final matrix and old convolution tuple are not charged extra HBM copies. Projection/norm/gate proxies retain their declared on-chip internal workspace and explicit execution-only conversions.

One shared BF16 causal mask is created for models containing MLA and retained until its last reader. Dense future score/AV work and storage remain executed; useful work counts causal pairs. FP32 probability materialization and BF16 output conversion are separate nodes. Expanded K/V contains all Q rows and is not a latent cache.

Artificial 262144-byte prefill device with BF16 matrix 2000 operations/s, FP32 vector 1000 operations/s and HBM 100 bytes/s. Serial last-use liveness, no implicit networking/fusion or real-kernel speed/accuracy claim. Existing decode asset identities and contents are preserved.
